visual.general_description: Four color clinical photographs (A to D) of a newborn showing a raised sac-like lesion with an open red center on the back, from distant to close-up views.
visual.detailed_description: A is a wider view of the newborn lying on white cloth with the head at the left in a gloved hand, the lesion on the back and a twisted umbilical cord at the right. B, C and D are progressively closer or differently angled views of the same raised lesion with an open oval center, pale pink rim, glistening pale tissue with fine vessels and a moist red-dark area. White coating is present on the skin. Panel letters A to D are printed at the lower left of each panel. No rulers, scale bars, text labels or numeric values are visible in any panel.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a newborn lying on white cloth with a round open skin-defect sac on the back and the umbilical cord visible.
panels.detailed_description: A newborn lies on white cloth, seen from the side/back with the head at the left held in a gloved hand; the head surface is rounded and dark gray-brown with dark hair visible. A rounded, raised, sac-like swelling with a smooth pink rim sits on the dorsal trunk, with an open oval center that appears red and moist with a darker streak. Patches of white coating are present on the skin, and a twisted violet-blue umbilical cord lies at the right. A second gloved hand is at the right edge. The panel letter A is printed at lower left. No scale bar, ruler, text label or numeric value is visible.

visual.general_description: Six hematoxylin-eosin stained light microscopy panels (A to F) of placenta, umbilical cord, brain, lung, liver and kidney.
visual.detailed_description: A shows placental villi with red-filled vessels; B a thick concentric-walled cross-section with a small irregular lumen; C cortex-like tissue with the surface at the top and scattered nuclei; D densely cellular tissue with thin septa and red-filled channels; E crowded cellular tissue with a large red-cell-filled vessel; F fibrous streams with round cells and a large red-filled vessel. Panel letters A to F are printed at lower left. No scale bars or other text are visible.

panels.general_description: Pink-purple stained placental tissue with many villi and a few large blood-filled vessels.
panels.detailed_description: At low-to-medium power, numerous rounded and elongated pink-purple villous profiles with pale spaces between them fill the field. At upper left a large elongated vessel and a smaller round vessel are packed with red material; another round red-filled structure is at the bottom center and a smaller one at the right edge. A few small dark purple dots are scattered. Panel letter A at lower left.
